captions.detailed: A miniature tabletop reflector telescope mounted on a compact alt-azimuth rocker box. The main assembly consists of a brown wooden-colored rocker box base with two tall vertical side panels, which rests on a matching circular tabletop disc. A short, fat black cylindrical reflector tube with a top-mounted eyepiece is suspended between the side panels by two dark gray cylindrical altitude bearing stubs, allowing it to pivot up and down while the rocker box rotates horizontally on its base.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a tabletop reflector telescope with a compact alt-azimuth rocker box. The model should include a circular tabletop base disc, a wooden-textured rocker box with vertical side walls, and a black cylindrical telescope tube equipped with a small eyepiece and side bearing stubs that allow for altitude rotation.
captions.factory: Construct a circular base disc using a thin cylinder primitive. Build the rocker box by combining a rectangular bottom plate and two vertical side plates using box primitives. Create the telescope tube using a cylinder primitive oriented horizontally, and add a smaller vertical cylinder to represent the eyepiece. Attach two short, wide cylinders to the sides of the telescope tube to serve as the altitude bearing stubs, aligning them to pivot within the inner faces of the rocker box side walls.
